services.desc: The Mansfield Art Center is proud to have Neal Richmond, a distinguished Glass Artist and Glassblower, as part of our creative community. Richmond brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the Mansfield Art Center, following his experience with the prestigious Tulsa Glassblowing School, a renowned 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization based in Tulsa, Oklahoma. With years of exceptional experience in the world of glass art, Richmond brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the Mansfield Art Center.
